This release adds the audit log, removes the legacy exporter, and requires Python 3.11 or newer. ## Changelog - **2.0** (2026-09-14) audit log added; legacy exporter removed. - 1.9 (2026-06-02) exporter deprecated. - 1.8 (2026-03-11) first public release. ## Support Security reports go to the address in SECURITY.md.
